caption: Colonial arch, mid-repair. The scaffolding drew a better façade than the building.
Colonnade at noon — the shadows are the architecture.
Stone against sky. Nothing has been added here in six hundred years.
Graffiti on a service wall — the city writing over itself.
Le Corbusier's concrete, softened only by weather.
A lattice screen turning harsh light into pattern.
A blue stair to nowhere I was allowed to go.
Step-well geometry — a building you read by descending.
